comments: Launched mid-2026. The accessibility battery is axe-core based and runs on a sample of pages within a broader automated site audit; the delivered report states explicitly which checks could not run. Methodology: https://go-voltic.com/methodology — crawler documentation: https://go-voltic.com/crawler
features: Automated website audit that walks up to 40 public pages of a live site in a real browser and runs an axe-core accessibility battery on sampled pages, alongside speed and structure checks. Findings are ranked with the page, the fix and the evidence; checks that could not run are stated rather than omitted.
title: Go Voltic Deep Scan
